author: CNN
description:
The Trump administration has indicted former Cuban President Raúl Castro, 94, on charges that stem from his alleged role in the 1996 shootdown of two civilian aircraft that killed four people, including three Americans. While announcing the charges, which include conspiracy to kill US nationals, Acting US Attorney General Todd Blanche said President Donald Trump “will not forget its citizens.” Cuba’s current president called the indictment a “political maneuver without any legal basis.”

The indictment comes at a tense time for US-Cuban relations, with the Trump administration declaring the Cuban government is a threat to US national security. Cuba is also dealing with a collapse of its energy sector due to an oil blockade following the US attack on Cuba’s oil-rich ally Venezuela.

author: CNN
description:
The Internal Revenue Service can’t bring claims against President Donald Trump, his family or businesses for past tax issues, according to additional terms added Tuesday to the settlement the Justice Department reached with Trump to resolve his $10 billion lawsuit against the IRS. 

The additional terms, first reported by Politico, were quietly added in a hyperlink to Monday’s Justice Department press release that contained an agreement to create a nearly $1.8 billion fund to compensate people or organizations that have been “weaponized” by past administrations — a fund widely expected to benefit Trump’s allies, including January 6, 2021, US Capitol rioters. 

CNN’s Alayna Treene reports from the White House. Democratic Reps. Debbie Dingell (MI) and Jake Auchincloss (MA) react to the news. Also, CNN’s Laura Coates’ panel breaks down Trump’s settlement of his lawsuit against the IRS from the right and the left. 

0:00 Dem. Rep. Debbie Dingell gives a heated reaction to Trump’s settleme
title: IRS ‘forever’ barred from investigating Trump's past taxes: CNN reacts

description:
Ed Gallrein will defeat incumbent Rep. Thomas Massie in the Republican primary in Kentucky’s 4th Congressional District, CNN’s Decision Desk projects.

The district is solidly Republican but the race was a test of President Donald Trump’s control of his party. Massie has drawn the ire of Trump and has broken with Republicans frequently during the president’s second term. As a result, Gallrein, a farmer and former Navy SEAL, was recruited into the race by Trump and his allies. He went into the race with the president’s endorsement.
